description.value: The Kaslo Visitor Centre is the official tourism information office for Kaslo and the surrounding Kootenay Lake area, operated by the Kootenay Lake Historical Society. Situated in the charming lakeside town of Kaslo in the West Kootenays, it serves as a natural first stop for visitors seeking local knowledge and regional resources. Touring cyclists arriving in Kaslo would likely find it a useful hub for area route information and local orientation.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The OSM record is a legitimate visitor information office operated by the Kootenay Lake Historical Society at 324 Front Street in Kaslo, BC. The discovered website URL (visitkaslo.com) does not belong to the Kaslo Visitor Centre — its content reveals it is the site of an independent local guide publisher (Karma Halleran / KS•Perry Publishing), making it entirely unusable for amenity verification. With no usable website evidence and no amenity-specific OSM tags, all amenity fields must be set to null.

enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: The Kaslo Visitor Centre is a plausible WWC listing as a cyclist waypoint, but the discovered website URL belongs to a local guide publisher rather than the visitor centre, leaving all amenities unverifiable; manual outreach is needed to confirm bike parking, washrooms, and other cyclist-relevant facilities before inclusion.
